chart.title: Share of small arms and light weapons with illicit origin
chart.subtitle: Seized, found, or surrendered arms whose illicit origin or context has been traced or established. Small arms and light weapons include easily transportable weapons such as handguns and light machine guns.
chart.citation: United Nations Office on Drugs and Crime and UN Office for Disarmament Affairs
